newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks mixed in OTC trade.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks mixed in OTC trade.

text.p: Following is the closing report for Croatia's Varazdin over-the-counter market for Tuesday, October 8.
* Six of 12 traded issues rose, three fell and three were unchanged.
* Ten-stock VIN index up 9.31 percent to 8,489 points.
* Volume higher at 12,883 units, turnover 516,308 German marks.
* Biggest gainer hotelier Arenaturist jumped 27.27 percent to 70 marks with 494 shares sold. Followed by:
- Varazdinska Banka second issue, which rose 19.05 percent to 150 marks, but only sold two shares,
- Tour operator Atlas, up 12 percent to 56 marks on volume of 150 shares
- Hotelier Istraturist, adding 10.77 percent to 72 marks with 217 shares sold
- Confectioner Kras, up 5.0 percent to 210 marks on volume of 177 and
- Textile firm Varteks, which was also most actively traded on volume 8,871, up 5.0 percent to 21 marks a share.
* Biggest loser was electronics firm Ericsson Tesla, whose shares fell 8.0 percent to 46 marks each on volume of 228. Two others were:
- Hotelier Riviera, down 2.86 percent to 68 marks with 209 shares traded, although it rose to an all time high of 280 kuna (3.5636 kuna = DM 1) on Zagreb's bourse.
- Hoteli Jelsa, down 0.18 percent to 28.45 marks with 82 shares sold.
- Cable maker Elka, closing at 60 marks on volume of 1,185.
- Food processor Podravka at 75 marks on volume of 1,044,
- Hotelier Laguna at 300 marks with 224 shares. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
